article.title: Big 12 matchup features TCU squaring off against Kansas
article.linkText: Big 12 matchup features TCU squaring off against Kansas
article.story: Kansas (3-4) at TCU (3-4), Oct. 31 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: TCU by 5.5. Against the spread: TCU 3-4, Kansas 1-5. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats TCU Offense Overall: 405.4 yards per game (57th in FBS) Passing: 295.1 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 110.3 yards per game (124th) Scoring: 23.4 points per game (101st) TCU Defense Overall: 264.3 yards per game (6th in FBS) Passing: 158.9 yards per game (9th) Rushing: 105.4 yards per game (23rd) Scoring: 13.9 points per game (6th) Kansas Offense Overall: 445.6 yards per game (26th in FBS) Passing: 238.1 yards per game (58th) Rushing: 207.4 yards per game (20th) Scoring: 31.0 points per game (55th) Kansas Defense Overall: 350.0 yards per game (61st in FBS) Passing: 183.1 yards per game (30th) Rushing: 166.9 yards per game (99th) Scoring: 24.0 points per game (68th) Kansas ranks 96th in third down percentage, converting 36.4% of the time. TCU ranks 15th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 30.6%. TCU is 112th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 77.8% of trips. Kansas' red zone defense ranks 43rd at 80.0%. TCU is 22nd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:19. Team leaders TCU Passing: Jaden Craig, 2,066 yards, 11 TDs, 6 INTs, 67.5 completion percentage Rushing: Jeremy Payne, 429 yards on 88 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Ed Small, 514 yards on 38 catches, 2 TDs Kansas Passing: Isaiah Marshall, 1,506 yards, 11 TDs, 7 INTs, 53.6 completion percentage Rushing: Dylan Edwards, 532 yards on 105 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Nik McMillan, 466 yards on 25 catches, 5 TDs Last game TCU was beaten by West Virginia 24-20 on Oct. 24. Craig led TCU with 372 yards on 33-of-47 passing (70.2%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball 12 times for 26 yards and one rushing touchdown. Jon Denman carried the ball 15 times for 58 yards, adding one reception for 15 yards. Kari Ashley put up 118 yards on six catches. Kansas won 25-24 over Baylor on Oct. 24. Marshall led Kansas with 212 yards on 17-of-29 passing (58.6%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 31 yards and one rushing touchdown. Edwards carried the ball 30 times for 156 yards, adding three receptions for 15 yards. McMillan had two receptions for 66 yards and one touchdown. Next game TCU plays at No. 22 Arizona on Nov. 6. Kansas hosts UCF on Nov. 7.
